title: Secret objectives: one per combat
description: Report fb_1792303387_e0ee89e2: a tester held Brave the Void and Demonstrate Your Power, both met after one combat, scored one and was not offered the other. The engine is right (the cards say 'Only 1 objective can be scored during or after each combat.'), but the UI never said so. The cap now shows on the held-secret line and in the scoring window, which also marks the secret that is skipped once the other is picked. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- FM.
